meaning: Verify source-derived Operation wrapper/provider interoperability with original Rule guards, Event constructors, and explicitly selected owned-value providers, preserving transaction and uncertainty semantics.
inputs: Registered source graph, selected reconciled plan and complete boundary with equal certificate, source manifest and plan identity. Exact definition bytes; no synthetic record, Rule, Event, Query, Calculation or Mapping.

relations: typed value occurrence selects owned adapter
owned children feed selected factory creation
source Event slot selects constructor and clock
explicit fixture settles reads and atomic commit
independent observation binds actual provider calls
non_relations: conceptual graph relation is not an implicit executable call
selected factory extension is not implicit adoption

source_surface.derivation: Exact roles, paths, export names and types derive from checked source/configuration; provider imports are guards in action order, unique Event targets in code-unit order with type imports, then cached owned adapters visited from result type before write types. Record fields preserve checked declaration order. Type-only Event/Operation wrapper reexports are explicit, never general export permission.
source_surface.closure: Every source Operation represented. Recursively include Rule references, selected factories, Enums, sums and selected field-reference type imports. Event references remain identity strings, not implicit imported entities. Bind complete independently derived closure to captured artifacts and compare all ordered import occurrences and export kinds. Preserve boundary edges outside this family as uncovered.
source_surface.registration: Separately weak-register surface; reject clones, foreign graph/plan/boundary and definition drift. Static matched modules are not runtime interoperability evidence.

protocol.initialization: Original module load forwards original execute/make identity. Cache each distinct named adapter type per Operation provider. Factory imports follow first traversal, constructor calls follow child-before-parent adapter initialization; separate setup from per-case execution.
protocol.execution: Input capture, awaited begin/read and identity checks, ordered short-circuit guards, source-order writes with recursive owned validation, ordered Event constructor calls by occurrence slot, result validation, one awaited atomic commit. Explicit clocks captured before begin. Rejected guards and failures omit all successor calls.
protocol.owned: Original factory constructor and create, plain Enum fromVariant, named sum create. Nested original owned results feed parent factory arguments. Root validation returns may be discarded and must not change structural stored/output values. No extension adoption or synthesized invariant.
protocol.observation: Exact qualified provider and method, arity, argument views and identity links, original return or error, input descriptor stability. Duplicate/wrong calls that preserve outputs must reject. Distinguish repeated Event slots and cached adapters from unique imports.
protocol.fixtures: Deterministic test-owned begin/read/commit/rollback and clocks only. Preserve missing reads, identity mismatch, failed owned values, generated/required event time, invalid receipts and indeterminate commit with no retry or automatic compensation.
protocol.capacity: Source-derived finite case coverage must include compound record/Event and enum-only/scalar inputs. Unavailable witnesses or resource exhaustion make the whole family not_evaluable, never a prefix pass.

audit: Dedicated source/native AST profile. Preserve Operation effect restrictions including ambient clock/Promise prohibition outside types, EnumContractError and materialize exceptions only for exact pinned runtime. Permit only checked named imports, exact type-only wrapper reexports, CommonJS compiler marker/export initialization, and frozen wrapper assignment from its imported execute/make. Retained currentness and original-call checks remain required beyond AST checks.
execution: Reuse private retained executor only after registration, exact source/native audits and original observer exist. Fingerprint source artifacts, generated modules, options, Node and complete TypeScript/platform tools before and after child execution and receipt assertion; reject stale/cloned/empty evidence.
claim_ceiling: Finite private instrumented original-provider interoperability only after all behavioral, source/native and retained-custody obligations pass. Surface readiness alone is not execution or ae11 completion. No public aggregation, generator/default change, publication, release, admission or authority.
